name: ClassTrack
description_en:
ClassTrack combines education administration and learning management for colleges, with current positioning focused on Canada. Admissions, cohorts, attendance, teaching, grading and finance appear within a common institutional platform.

Its public pricing contains a material inconsistency: an approximate annual per-student headline does not reconcile with the monthly plan cards. A purchase decision requires a written scope and currency rather than a copied starting price.
description_zh:
ClassTrack 将学院教务管理与学习管理结合，当前定位侧重加拿大，招生、班组、出勤、教学、评分和财务位于同一机构平台。

公开价格存在重要不一致：按学生年费的概略标题与月付套餐卡无法对应。采购需要书面确认范围及币种，不能直接复制起价。

core_features.explanation_zh: 按入学批次、学期和项目组织学生。

core_features.explanation_zh: 结合课程章节、内容和量规考核。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Annual headline conflicts with monthly cards; currency and asterisk terms unresolved; numeric normalized price unset.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 年费标题与月付卡冲突，币种及星号条件未明，标准金额留空。

sources.title: ClassTrack — the all-in-one education platform for Canadian colleges
sources.research_notes_en: Read college positioning, sample admissions/cohort/learning-hub modules and role-specific workflow descriptions.

sources.title: ClassTrack Pricing — about $10 per student per year
sources.research_notes_en: Read approximate annual headline against $500/$1500 monthly cards and demo-limited trial; preserved contradiction and unknown currency.

official_check.scope: Public official documentation research; no account, purchase, live workflow, performance, owner identity or publication approval verified.

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Administrative operations and the learning hub
sections.en: The homepage demonstrates admissions documents, intake/cohort grouping, a learning hub with course chapters and media, grading rubrics and institutional administration. The displayed command-centre values are sample interface material, not audited customer activity. ClassTrack is broader than a standalone course player, so evaluating only content upload would miss student and finance data responsibilities.
sections.zh: 首页展示招生文件、入学批次与班组、含章节和媒体的学习中心、评分量规及机构管理。界面示例中的控制中心数据并非经审计的客户活动。它比独立课程播放器更广，因此只评估内容上传会漏掉学生和财务数据责任。

sections.title_en: Example: enroll and assess one pilot cohort
sections.title_zh: 示例：登记并考核一个试点班组
sections.en: Create a small intake, associate students with a program, assign a chapter and an assessment, then verify that tutor and student accounts see the appropriate records. Compare rubric weighting and the resulting report with an expected calculation. Use synthetic documents for any admissions or AI demonstration, and test an incomplete application as well as a successful one. This is an evaluation plan, not a deployed college workflow.
sections.zh: 创建小型入学批次，把学生关联到课程项目，分配章节和考核，再检查教师与学生账户是否看到相应记录。把量规权重及报告结果与预期计算对照。招生或 AI 演示应使用合成文件，同时检查不完整申请及成功路径。本例是评估方案，并非已部署的学院流程。

sections.title_en: Resolve annual headlines and monthly plan cards
sections.title_zh: 解决年费标题与月付套餐冲突
sections.en: The pricing headline says about $10 per student per year, while Tutor shows $500 per month for 50 students and Plan 10 shows $1,500 per month for 200. Currency and the asterisk conditions are not resolved by the extracted text. Enterprise is custom, and Free Trial has demo student limits and limited features. These figures cannot be combined into a credible normalized rate; leave the amount unset and request a written quote specifying modules, headcount and term.
sections.zh: 定价标题写每名学生每年约 10 元，Tutor 却列每月 500 元、50 名学生，Plan 10 列每月 1,500 元、200 名学生。读取文本无法确定币种和星号条件。Enterprise 为定制报价，Free Trial 为演示人数及有限功能。这些金额无法合成可信标准价，因此留空，需书面确认模块、人数及周期。

sections.title_en: Verify role separation and student-record migration
sections.title_zh: 验证角色隔离与学生记录迁移
sections.en: Start with the demo and a clear inventory of existing admissions, academic and financial records. Confirm which modules and API/LTI connections are included rather than assuming every homepage tile is enabled. The platform may fit a college seeking integrated administration; an independent course seller may need much less. Deployment, source licensing, statutory reporting and recovery were not verified.
sections.zh: 从演示和现有招生、教务、财务数据清单开始，确认包含的模块及 API/LTI 连接，不能假定首页每个功能块都已开通。希望整合行政管理的学院可考虑它，独立课程销售者可能只需要更小范围。部署、源码许可、法定报告和恢复未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source documentation research, original English synthesis and Chinese translation; examples are hypothetical and unexecuted.

research_gaps.en: Obtain a current currency-specific module quote and verify permissions, migration, data retention and financial integrations.
research_gaps.zh: 需取得按币种及模块明确的当前报价，并检查权限、迁移、保留期限和财务集成。

research_gaps.en: No live account, purchase, recovery or performance test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际创建账户、购买、测试恢复或测量性能。
